result.brief: 分析 JEPA 潜空间目标代价缺乏时间序，提出基于轨迹三元组与 margin 排序损失的 Time-to-Goal 度量，在冻结编码器下提升长程潜空间规划成功率。
result.reason: Analyzes JEPA latent goal-cost temporal ordering and learns a metric on frozen JEPA latents; contributes to JEPA-style representation use for planning, though main contribution is planning cost.
